verdict.rationale: The only programmatic channel the CRA documents is EFILE. Certified tax software run by an enrolled electronic filer transmits returns to the CRA system-to-system, so some non-interactive submission exists (cra-supp-3, cra-docs-14, cra-docs-19). Beyond that, the CRA's own pages show only browser portals for registration, payments and document submission. EFILE is limited to return filing, requires vendor certification and filer enrolment, and nothing shows it running in CI or scripted pipelines. Missing for 10: a general-purpose public API or CLI, self-serve credentials for automation, headless coverage of registration, payments and documents, and any CI or automation guidance.
